output.revised_prompt: Create an original premium mobile slot game lobby background, portrait 2:3, full bleed. Scene: an expansive jade lantern court at evening, viewed with elegant architectural depth. A grand central circular moon gate opens into a lush, glowing treasure garden beyond, establishing a strong focal point. Surround the court with four clearly distinct illuminated architectural alcoves—two on each side or balanced around the courtyard—each suitable as a separate game destination while remaining naturally integrated into one cohesive building. Rich carved dark-wood beams, polished jade-green roof tiles and floor inlays, refined brass lantern chains, and a delicate pearl rain curtain. Warm lantern light, soft drifting motes, subtle evening haze, grounded contact shadows, layered foreground/midground/background, premium festive and wealthy atmosphere. Refined stylized 3D illustration, sophisticated materials, cinematic global illumination, high-end mobile game key art, ornate but uncluttered. Composition must preserve a clear open lower-center path for navigation and a calm, clean upper-center area for future branding. Make all four alcoves readable and visually differentiated through decor, color temperature, and interior treasure motifs, but avoid isolated or floating elements. No text, no letters, no logo, no UI cards, no casino machine, no slot machine, no people or characters, no floating sticker objects, no flat solid-color background, no hard neon glow, no watermark.
